about: Every seat in The Marketing Room. room.py reads this file: ids, groups, native lenses, tension partners, and who is accountable for each deliverable key. The expertise for each seat lives in seats/<id>.md and is pasted into that seat's briefs. Edit freely; keep ids unique and lowercase-hyphen.

groups.standing: Considered for every brief. client-lead is always cast; measurement is cast whenever an ad seat is.
groups.bench: Cast only when the brief gives a reason (a trigger quote).
groups.process: Run the session. Never cast as a seat.

seats.name: Google Ads Lead
seats.summary: Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, Shopping; bidding, keywords, feeds, Quality Score.

seats.name: Meta Ads Lead
seats.summary: Facebook and Instagram: Advantage+, audiences, CAPI, learning phase, creative testing and fatigue.

seats.name: LinkedIn Ads Lead
seats.summary: B2B paid social: targeting, ABM lists, Lead Gen Forms, Thought Leader Ads, high CPCs, lead quality.

seats.name: SEO Lead
seats.summary: Technical SEO, content, Core Web Vitals, AI Overviews and answer engines, site architecture.

seats.name: UX Lead
seats.summary: Journeys, landing-page flow, forms, friction, accessibility, research and testing.

seats.name: Developer
seats.summary: Builds pages and integrations: tags, server-side tracking, CAPI, page speed, CMS, CRM plumbing.

seats.name: UI Designer
seats.summary: Visual design of pages and ad templates, design system, brand consistency from ad to page.

seats.name: Creative Strategist
seats.summary: Insight, big idea, messaging angles, hooks, concept testing plan across channels.

seats.name: Creative Operations Lead
seats.summary: Production capacity, asset matrix, specs per placement, naming, versioning, trafficking and QA.

seats.name: Measurement & Analytics Lead
seats.summary: GA4, GTM, server-side tagging, Enhanced Conversions, CAPI, consent, attribution, MMM, reporting.

seats.name: Client Lead
seats.summary: Owns the client relationship: scope, budget split, approvals, cadence, expectations, client questions.

seats.name: Copywriter
seats.summary: Ad copy per platform, landing-page copy, message match from ad to page, claims language.

seats.name: TikTok Ads Lead
seats.summary: TikTok paid: Smart+ and manual campaigns, Spark Ads, creator content, Events API, fast creative fatigue.

seats.name: YouTube & Video Lead
seats.summary: YouTube and CTV: video reach, Demand Gen video, views, brand lift, video formats and sequencing.

seats.name: Programmatic Lead
seats.summary: DV360, The Trade Desk and other DSPs: open web, CTV, audio, DOOH, deals, brand safety, frequency.

seats.name: Amazon Ads Lead
seats.summary: Sponsored Products, Brands and Display, Amazon DSP, retail readiness, ACoS and TACoS.

seats.name: CRM & Email Lead
seats.summary: Lifecycle, email and SMS flows, lead nurture, CRM sync and lead routing, consent lists, deliverability.

seats.name: Project Head
seats.summary: Opens the room (brief breakdown, casting) and closes it (rulings, review, ship).

seats.name: Facilitator
seats.summary: Neutral. Groups the debate into conflicts, proposes compromises from the parties' own positions, and writes the integrated deliverable.
